item.title: About
item.description: Hey, I’m Connor: a product-minded software engineer with experience across a wide range of technologies. I studied Electrical and Computer Engineering at Carnegie Mellon, and since then I’ve pretty much lived in the startup world. I’ve worked at companies across the whole spectrum — a tiny founding team, fast-growing seed and Series A startups, and a Series D unicorn that became one of the fastest-growing digital health companies ever. The pace was chaotic at times, but I’ve always found the energy of startups exhilarating and enjoyed building things from scratch.
